components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single forward or save action, including the sticky editor action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #A83211; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 14px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outlined Add Button
components.description: Creates a whole section, step, or nutrition item without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1.5px solid #6F554F; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #A83211; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outlined:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tonal Add Button
components.description: Adds content within an existing editorial module.
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFDBD1; color: #A83211; font: 600 14px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { filter: saturate(1.08); } .ds-btn-tonal:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filled Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { min-height: 52px; padding: 8px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #F3ECE2; color: #59413B; font: 400 12px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #1B1B21; font: 400 15px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { background: #EFE6DB; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: #A83211; } .ds-field:focus-within span { color: #A83211; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: The main paper-like container for a complete editing module.
components.html:
Ingredients

Group the mise en place into named sections.
components.css: .ds-editorial-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFDF9; color: #1B1B21; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(84, 62, 45, 0.078); transition: box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-editorial-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 20px/1.23 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.35px; } .ds-editorial-card p { margin: 0; color: #59413B; font: 400 13px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-editorial-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(84, 62, 45, 0.1); } .ds-editorial-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-recipe-summary { padding: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: #F3ECE2; color: #1B1B21; } .ds-recipe-summary__thumb { width: 58px; height: 58px; flex: 0 0 58px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8B4C00, #FFDBD1); } .ds-recipe-summary__copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-recipe-summary__copy strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 600 18px/1.23 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.35px; } .ds-recipe-summary__copy span { color: #59413B; font: 400 12px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-recipe-summary > b { color: #8B4C00; font: 700 11px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-recipe-summary:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nutrition Row
components.description: A reorderable per-serving label and free-form value row that tolerates long localized names.
components.html: ⠿Saturated fatty acids
components.css: .ds-nutrition-row { min-height: 68px; padding: 10px 8px 10px 6px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(96px, 116px) 48px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(111, 85, 79, 0.12); border-radius: 12px; background: #F3ECE2; color: #1B1B21; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nutrition-row__drag { text-align: center; color: #59413B; font-size: 24px; } .ds-nutrition-row strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-nutrition-row input { min-width: 0; height: 46px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(111, 85, 79, 0.45); border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFDF9; color: #1B1B21; text-align: right; font: 400 14px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nutrition-row button { width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #59413B; font-size: 25px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nutrition-row button:hover { background: rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.08); color: #A83211; } .ds-nutrition-row input:focus-visible, .ds-nutrition-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A83211; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-stage-header { padding: 12px 20px; background: #FAF7F2; color: #1B1B21; box-shadow: 0 1px 10px rgba(84, 62, 45, 0.078); } .ds-stage-header > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-stage-header > div span { color: #A83211; font: 700 11px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.8px; } .ds-stage-header > div strong { font: 600 19px/1.23 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.35px; } .ds-stage-header nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(24px, 1fr)) auto; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-stage-header nav i { height: 5px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #EAE0D4; } .ds-stage-header nav i.ds-stage-header__done { background: #A83211; } .ds-stage-header nav b { margin-left: 7px; font: 700 11px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-stage-header:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgba(168, 50, 17, 0.24); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Culinary Editorial world turns structured recipe work into the feeling of composing a trusted kitchen notebook: warm, deliberate, and quietly authoritative. Parchment grounds and tonal paper modules reduce glare, while expressive serif headings give each stage a clear editorial voice. Technical content stays compact and dependable in a geometric sans serif.

The system is tactile without becoming ornamental. Burnt-red actions, restrained sage and amber semantics, generous working surfaces, and persistent navigation support people editing on a phone with divided attention. Material behavior, safe areas, keyboard avoidance, and real recipe data remain the foundation beneath the journal character.

This world is established for participating Culinary Editorial surfaces, led by the four-stage recipe editor. It does not authorize restyling unrelated legacy screens or importing unsupported concepts from visual references.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment canvas with paper-like tonal layering.
Playfair Display editorial hierarchy paired with Plus Jakarta Sans utility text.
Burnt-red primary actions with sparing sage and amber semantic accents.
Rounded rectangular controls built around 10, 12, and 14 dp corners.
A focused, single-column authoring measure with persistent stage progress and actions.

rules.name: The Ember Rarity Rule
rules.body: Burnt Paprika marks focus and forward motion; do not flood large passive regions with it.

rules.name: The Semantic Pantry Rule
rules.body: Sage means positive or completed and amber means measured emphasis; neither substitutes for the primary action role.

rules.name: The OLED Ground Rule
rules.body: Only the OLED background is pure black; editable surfaces keep tonal separation instead of disappearing into the canvas.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display speaks hierarchy; Plus Jakarta Sans does the work. Never use the serif for field values, measurements, or controls.

rules.name: The Scaling Rule
rules.body: Treat Flutter sizes as scalable text roles and allow wrapping or ellipsis where implemented; do not lock text into decorative fixed-height compositions.

rules.name: The One-Stage Rule
rules.body: Present one authoring stage at a time and keep the shared progress, summary, and navigation shell stable across all four stages.

rules.name: The Kitchen Reach Rule
rules.body: Interactive targets are at least 48 dp; principal controls are 52 dp high and remain reachable above system and keyboard insets.

rules.name: The Paper Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface tone first; add elevation only to persistent chrome and complete card modules.

rules.name: The Three-Corner Rule
rules.body: Default to 10 dp for fields, 12 dp for actions and rows, and 14 dp for modules; introduce another radius only for a specific native affordance.

dos: Do preserve the four-stage General, Ingredients, Instructions, and Nutrition story with visible progress and stable sticky actions.
Do use role-based light, dark, and OLED mappings so contrast and surface hierarchy survive every theme.
Do keep real recipe content, stable ingredient identity, free-form nutrition values, localization, and native Material behavior intact.
Do cap authoring content at 760 dp and reflow dense ingredient rows below 420 dp.
Do maintain 48 dp minimum touch targets, scalable text, semantic labels, keyboard-safe layout, and reduced-motion compatibility.
donts: Don't revive the legacy gradient editor, glassmorphism, or ad-dense recipe-blog styling inside this world.
Don't add AI parsing, inventory, timers, video, profiles, hands-free mode, or other unsupported reference concepts.
Don't turn the editor into a wide multi-column dashboard; tablet layouts preserve the focused authoring measure.
Don't use Paprika, Sage, and Amber interchangeably or rely on any accent as the sole carrier of meaning.
Don't replace the approved nutrition list with a metric grid or force values into a unit model the product does not store.
